dimensions.assessment: Involves Medicare beneficiaries utilizing telehealth services and administrative personnel compiling federal health data.
dimensions.evidence: with respect to claims for telehealth services for which payment was made under this subsection

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative data reporting, transparency requirements, and a public website dashboard rather than altering patient care or benefits.
dimensions.evidence: establish and maintain on the internet website of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services a publicly available dashboard

dimensions.assessment: The source does not specify any appropriations or funding amounts required to implement the reporting and dashboard.
Amends Medicare statutory provisions to add specific reporting and transparency mandates for federal agencies.
dimensions.evidence: establish reporting and transparency requirements for data related to telehealth services under the Medicare program.

dimensions.assessment: Creates ongoing annual reporting requirements and a permanent public dashboard.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this paragraph, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Estimated administrative costs for HHS to produce the required reports and dashboard.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Secretary of Health and Human Services to compile annual reports on Medicare telehealth claims, disaggregated by demographics, and establish a public dashboard. It does not alter Medicare benefits or coverage rules directly.
